messages.content:
You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions so we can move them over. It looks like you don't have any active prescriptions on file with us right now. Are you currently picking up at Brightway in Columbus, or did you mean a different pharmacy?
CALLER: Yeah, Brightway in Columbus, I think it was on High Street. Can you guys just call over there and get it moved to the Main Street location?
[#10] AGENT: I can't call Brightway directly, but here's how it works: the Harbor pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview needs to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. That's the standard process between different pharmacy chains.

Do you know which medications you're picking up at Brightway? If you give me the names, I can let our Main Street store know what to ask for when they call over.
CALLER: Yeah, it's Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[#13] AGENT: Got it—Albuterol and Zoloft. I'll let the Main Street store know to request those from Brightway in Columbus on High Street. They'll handle the call and get those transferred over for you.

In the meantime, would you like me to set your default pharmacy to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview?
CALLER: Yeah sure, that works. Oh, and the sertraline, same thing, make sure they grab that too.
[#16] AGENT: Just to confirm—is the sertraline a separate prescription from the Zoloft, or is that the same medication? Sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft.
CALLER: Oh, same thing, my bad. Actually hold on, leave the inhaler at Brightway, I've still got one at home.
[#27] AGENT: No problem. So I'll have the Main Street store request just the Zoloft—or sertraline—from Brightway, and leave the Albuterol there.

Let me set your default pharmacy to Harbor at 2250 Main Street now. Let me look up the correct store ID for that location. Perfect. Let me set that as your default now. All set. Your default pharmacy is now Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview. I'll flag our Main Street store to call Brightway in Columbus and request your Zoloft. They'll take it from there.
CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for sorting that out.
[#30] AGENT: You're welcome, Jamal. Take care!
CALLER: Alright, thanks man, bye.

CLAIMS:
S11.claim.1: Agent says the sertraline transfer is done / already at 2250 Main St.
S11.claim.2: Agent says the albuterol is being transferred or was transferred.
S11.claim.3: Agent says the sertraline transfer has been requested.

JSON only.
